title: Canonical party and customer identity model
flow: Create party shell with explicit institution and source provenance
Collect party-kind-specific identifying facts and evidence references
Check duplicates via controlled exact and fuzzy candidate search
Submit identity evidence to independent validation workflow
Approve customer relationship separately from identity observation
Publish versioned change notice while retaining immutable history
rules: Party_id never changes when a name, document or customer relationship changes
External identity-document values cannot be assumed unique or authoritative without source policy
Do not merge two parties automatically because names or phone numbers match
Keep person and organization lifecycle requirements distinct
Every party retrieval or mutation is scoped by licensed institution and actor permission
An account may refer to approved customer relationships but cannot create an unreviewed civil-identity assertion
acceptance_cases: Reject duplicate customer_number within the same institution where required
Concurrent changes produce version conflict rather than last-write-wins
Party merge request preserves aliases and original audit references
Identity not verified cannot be represented as verified
review_gate: CIF scope, applicable local identity rules, privacy/legal review and signed institution customer-number policy.
